data.description: This spell functions like summon monster I, except that you can summon one creature from the 3rd-level list, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 2nd-level list, or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list.

source.record_key: Summon Monster III.COPY=Summon Monster III (lantern archon only)
